recentItems.description:
T-Series Telugu presents  Yellow Chunni Song Launch Event LIVE From Itllu Arjuna Movie on ‪@TseriesTelugu 

Itlu Arjuna, a 2026 Telugu romantic action movie, starring Aniesh and Anaswara Rajan. Directed by Mahesh Uppala. Music composed by S. Thaman. Produced by Venky Kudumula under What Next Entertainments. The film marks Aniesh's debut as a lead actor and Mahesh Uppala's directorial debut.

A story driven by emotions, silence, and unspoken love, this marks the beginning of a musical journey built on fresh beats blending with heartfelt storytelling. 

Stay tuned as Arjuna’s world unfolds on 30th October.
